name: Tessera Industries Adaptive Disguise Matrix ADM-1
product_name: Tessera Industries Adaptive Disguise Matrix ADM-1
description: A facial prosthetic system using programmable matter that can reconfigure itself to replicate any human face from a stored template library. The ADM-1 is a thin membrane applied to the face that reshapes itself to alter bone structure appearance, skin texture, pigmentation, and feature proportions. A single unit can store up to 20 facial templates and switch between them in approximately 8 seconds. The disguise is convincing to human observers and defeats most facial recognition systems, though it cannot replicate retinal patterns or dental structure. Tessera's programmable matter technology gives the mask a lifelike quality that rigid prosthetics cannot match — the disguised face moves, expresses, and ages naturally.

specifications.limitations: Cannot replicate retinal patterns or dental structure

story_hooks: A murder suspect was positively identified by facial recognition at the crime scene — but they were confirmed to be elsewhere at the time, and the investigation reveals an ADM-1 was used to impersonate them.
An ADM-1 unit has malfunctioned while the wearer was in public — the face began cycling through stored templates uncontrollably, revealing 20 different identities to horrified bystanders.

physical_description.visual_profile: A nearly invisible second skin — a translucent, opalescent membrane that clings seamlessly to the face. When inactive, it appears as a subtle iridescent sheen across the wearer's features, almost imperceptible in normal lighting. During transformation, the surface ripples with bioluminescent patterns as the programmable matter reconfigures, creating an unsettling but mesmerizing effect. The membrane's surface mimics authentic skin — pores, fine wrinkles, stubble patterns, and even microexpressions render convincingly.
physical_description.dimensions: Facial coverage only — approximately 600 cm² of surface area spanning forehead to neck, cheekbone to cheekbone. Stored in a compact application kit the size of a credit card (8.5 × 5.4 × 0.3 cm).
physical_description.weight_description: 80 grams total — the membrane itself is imperceptible when worn; the application kit fits in a pocket or small pouch.
physical_description.primary_material: Tessera proprietary programmable matter composite — a responsive gel-polymer matrix with microscopic actuators. Housing for the storage cartridge is molded aerospace-grade polymer with embedded neural-response circuits.
physical_description.finish: The membrane has a wet-silk texture with subtle self-cleaning microbiology. The application cartridge has a matte charcoal finish with soft-touch grip zones. Contact points are polished stainless steel.
physical_description.color_scheme: The membrane is translucent with an underlying pearlescent sheen that shifts between violet and cyan depending on angle. The storage cartridge is gunmetal gray with white accent lines marking the activation points. LED indicator bands glow soft amber when idle, pulse cyan during transformation.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal tactile interface — a thumb-press activation pad on the cartridge, a small holographic display (2.2 cm diagonal) projecting the current template identity and remaining battery percentage. A neural-link port (type-μ) for wireless template download. Haptic feedback through the wearing membrane itself communicates system status.
distinctive_features: Bioluminescent reconfiguration waves visible across the face during transformation
Programmable matter surface that naturally sweats and responds to temperature
Barely-visible template indicator tattooed in UV-reactive ink on the inner wrist of the application kit
Self-healing micro-tears — the membrane can repair minor damage autonomously
Dual-mode activation: manual pressure or subcutaneous neural command (with implant upgrade)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Tessera Industries logo (a geometric Φ-shaped tessellation) embossed subtly on the storage cartridge. Regulatory stamp (GLMZ Bio-Prosthetic License Tier-4) and serial number printed in white on the underside. Safety warning in seven languages etched in 2pt font.
physical_description.condition_typical: In active use, the wearer appears completely natural — the disguise is flawless. The membrane's surface reflects light identically to human skin. Subtle condensation may form on the surface during high emotional stress (tension that bypasses the disguise's expression-mimicry). When transitioning between faces, the wearer's eyes briefly lose focus as neural receptors recalibrate.
